long_biography.plain_text:
Greenstein built his career in home textiles and licensed consumer brands. He co-founded Homestead in 1997 and helped combine it with London Fog, becoming chief executive of the enlarged group. After its restructuring, he led Homestead within Li & Fung and later served as president and chief executive of Himatsingka America, overseeing branded home-textile programs and sourcing operations.

In 2019 Greenstein founded Wonder Brands, an investment and incubation platform that commits its own capital and provides strategy, marketing, e-commerce and operating support to young consumer businesses. His portfolio activity spans swimwear, sustainable household products, food technology and other lifestyle concepts. He has also served on the board of Delivering Good, a nonprofit that distributes donated products through community partners.
